correctness.rationale: A circular output has a preimage iff its 4x4 Boolean de Bruijn product has nonzero diagonal. Closing the Boolean relation monoid yields exactly 75 states and 61 accepting; the deterministic subset automaton counts distinct outputs once. Independent fresh implementation checked all 75 states of T^2 p(T)f=0 for specified degree-nine integer polynomial p, the 11 initial values and direct images through n=16. This finite all-states operator identity, not empirical sequence extrapolation, proves rational GF for every n; logarithmic derivative of quartic factors yields lambda^n+O(1.381^n).
